## Baird Medical Highlights Global Expansion and Strategic Progress During Third Quarter 2026


October 5, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.bairdmed.com/node/7261/pdf)


**Quarter included presentation at H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference, strategic partnership with Alpmed, new regulatory registrations, and continued physician training**


NEW YORK, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Baird Medical Investment Holdings Ltd.** (“Baird Medical” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: BDMD), a medical device company focused on the development and commercialization of minimally invasive treatment technologies, today highlighted key business and operational developments from the third quarter of 2026, including expansion into new international markets, continued physician training initiatives and the addition of irreversible electroporation (IRE) technology to its broader technology portfolio through a strategic partnership.


“During the third quarter, we continued to execute on the priorities that we believe will drive Baird Medical’s long-term growth, including extension of our geographic reach, strengthening physician adoption and broadening our technology portfolio, while continuing to share our exciting story with the investment community,” said Haimei Wu, Chairwoman and CEO of Baird Medical. “These milestones reflect the progress we are making to build a more diversified global business and create additional opportunities for growth.”


**Presenting Baird Medical’s Growth Strategy at H.C. Wainwright**


In September, Baird Medical participated in the H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference in New York, where U.S. CEO Mark Saxton and Chief Strategy Officer Daphne Huang shared details on the Company’s progress and plans for continued growth.


The presentation highlighted Baird Medical’s expanding U.S. presence, growing adoption of its microwave ablation (MWA) technology and plans to build on its established international business. Management also discussed the Company’s efforts to expand its technology portfolio and reach more physicians and patients across a broader range of markets.


“Our focus this quarter was on execution, including bringing our technology into new markets, working directly with physicians, and adding new capabilities to our portfolio,” said Mark Saxton, U.S. Chief Executive Officer of Baird Medical. “At H.C. Wainwright, we had the opportunity to share that progress with investors and discuss where we see the business going from here. The work underway across our U.S. and international operations gives us a strong foundation as we head into the final months of the year.”


**Expanding the Technology Portfolio Through Alpmed Partnership**


In August, Baird Medical entered into a strategic partnership with Alpmed focused on the global development and commercialization of next-generation irreversible electroporation (IRE) technology.


The partnership adds another minimally invasive treatment modality alongside Baird Medical’s existing MWA business and provides a path to introduce IRE technology across international markets. The collaboration is part of the Company’s effort to build a broader portfolio of technologies for physicians performing minimally invasive procedures.


**Advancing Regulatory and Commercial Expansion in International Markets**


Baird Medical also made progress expanding the availability of its MWA technology in new markets during the quarter.


In August, the Company received registrations from the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) for its BD-GT microwave ablation system and T-1610 microwave ablation needle. The registrations allow Baird Medical to bring these products to the Pakistani market and represent another step in the Company’s international expansion.


The Company also marked the completion of first procedures using its MWA technology in Vietnam and Argentina during the quarter, extending the use of its technology into two additional markets.


**Connecting with Physicians at Global Medical Conferences**


Baird Medical continued its engagement with the international medical community during Q3 through participation in major industry meetings, including the Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) 2026 Annual Congress and the Asia Pacific Society of Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiology (APSCVIR) Annual Scientific Meeting.


These meetings provided opportunities for the Baird Medical team to connect directly with interventional radiologists and other specialists from around the world, exchange clinical experience, present the Company's technology in live settings, and discuss developments in minimally invasive treatment.


**Expanding Hands-On Physician Training**


Physician education remained an important area of focus during the quarter, with Baird Medical supporting training programs in both the U.S. and China.


In the U.S., the Company supported hands-on MWA training in New Orleans, where participating physicians observed procedures and gained practical experience with MWA techniques and applications.


In China, Baird Medical hosted a four-day MWA Master Class for Vietnamese physicians at The Eighth Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, combining clinical observation and hands-on training across multiple MWA applications.


**Looking Ahead**


As Baird Medical enters the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company remains focused on expanding its presence in key markets, supporting physician education and training, and advancing a broader portfolio of minimally invasive treatment technologies.


The Company expects to continue building on the clinical, commercial, and strategic progress achieved during the third quarter as it works to bring its technologies to more physicians and patients worldwide.


**About Baird Medical**


Baird Medical is a global, pioneering medical device company specializing in minimally invasive ablation technologies for a range of solid tumors. The Company’s lead product, a microwave ablation (MWA) system, is FDA-cleared for soft tissue ablation and is being launched in the U.S. primarily for the treatment of benign thyroid nodules. In addition, the Company is expanding its minimally invasive technology portfolio, including IRE-based products and an AI-powered robotic ablation system.


Baird Medical's MWA solutions have been adopted by a growing number of leading U.S. institutions and private practice groups, including the Mayo Clinic, Columbia University Medical Center, and The George Washington University Hospital. The company is rapidly expanding its global commercial footprint, with sales now reaching markets across multiple continents.
